title: LabResult
description: A Certificate of Analysis. Referenced (nested) from Package.lab_result. LabResult is authoritative for COA URL (public_url) and potency (cannabinoids). Label.optional.coa_qr_url and Label.cannabinoid_facts.cannabinoids are display copies only; when they disagree, LabResult wins.

batch_lot.description: Batch or lot identifier as a free string from the COA. One of three lot/batch shapes in core; see Label.identity_compliance.lot (Identifier) and Package.gtin (no lot carried; scheme=gtin only).
